abstract: Oversees architectural dimensions, floor loading, and structural venue configurations
system_message:
You are Facilities logistics director (FAC). The Facilities logistics director (FAC) oversees architectural dimensions, floor loading, and structural venue configurations across potential event sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: October 2026·Oversees architectural dimensions, floor loading, and structural venue configurations（PKMG）
information_points.content:
FAC-PKMG-QOR：Evaluations from the October 2026 survey period indicate that the Bonaventure Grand Exhibition Hall main plenary chamber floor plate maintains a minimum ceiling clearance height of 8 m and a gross exhibition floor area of 11000 m2 across the unpartitioned main hall footprint.
FAC-PKMG-6MG：Cadastral and laser scan surveys for the October 2026 survey period document that the Technoparc International Pavilion main plenary chamber floor plate offers a minimum ceiling clearance height of 14 m alongside an unpartitioned gross exhibition floor area of 10400 m2.
FAC-PKMG-YNB：During the October 2026 survey period, the architectural laser scan and cadastral evaluations for the Montréal Convention Centre West Wing recorded a minimum ceiling clearance height of 12 m across the main plenary chamber floor plate and a gross exhibition floor area of 8500 m2 in the unpartitioned main hall.

information_points.title: September 2026·Oversees architectural dimensions, floor loading, and structural venue configurations（SPAT）
information_points.content:
FAC-SPAT-S2R：According to the architectural laser scan and cadastral surveys for the September 2026 survey period, the Montréal Convention Centre West Wing main plenary chamber floor plate features a minimum ceiling clearance height of 10 m and an unpartitioned main hall footprint with a gross exhibition floor area of 11000 m2.
FAC-SPAT-YYM：Laser scan and spatial cadastral data from the September 2026 survey period show that the Technoparc International Pavilion main plenary chamber floor plate has a minimum ceiling clearance height of 14 m and an unpartitioned main hall gross exhibition floor area of 10400 m2.
FAC-SPAT-OEV：For the September 2026 survey period, the Bonaventure Grand Exhibition Hall main plenary chamber floor plate exhibits a minimum ceiling clearance height of 8 m, accompanied by an unpartitioned main hall gross exhibition floor area of 11000 m2 based on spatial cadastral records.
